title: When the Border Sings
author: Noor Galloway
blurb: Ada Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
